subject: Is it possible to add our own functionality to the rattleGUI

messages.author: 027e86e2d7290ed1
messages.subject: Is it possible to add our own functionality to the rattleGUI
parts:
I do not know if this is even possible.  I work with the gbm package quite a bit.  My productivity would be enhanced if I could bring this functionality in to the rattle environment.  My question is it possible to use an r source script to modify the rattleGUI (via RGtk2)?  My thought was to add a new tab for parameter input and results output windows.  I am new to RGtk2 but have a few references.  If someone has done this would love to see a general approach to adding a new tab pane with delineation of an input and text output area, as well as construction of an event handler to assess the input widgets and initiate processing. 

Thanks,
Bob

P.S. If this is possible but not practical that also would be good info to have.
